# Test fixtures — data attribution

## `pulse_bandA_100Hz.txt`

One period (10 ms, 30,000 samples at 3 MS/s) of the 100 Hz-PRF alternative
calibration waveform for CISPR 16-1-1 ed. 4 EMI receivers, CISPR Band A.
Values are open-circuit volts; divide by 2 for a 50 Ω load. The time axis is
defined by the sampling period (1/3 µs); the waveform is periodic at the PRF
(looped by an ARB generator in the calibration procedure) — tests tile it
accordingly.

- Source: M. Azpúrua, M. Hudlička, "Alternative waveforms for calibration of
  EMI receivers according to CISPR 16-1-1 ed. 4", Zenodo,
  DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17779465 — EURAMET project 21NRM06 EMC-STD.
- License: CC-BY-4.0.
- Background: M. A. Azpúrua, M. Pous, F. Silva, IEEE Trans. EMC 62(3):654-662,
  2020, DOI 10.1109/TEMC.2019.2923813.
